section: 4. Cement Plant: Character Attributes and Dice Rolls
description: Investigating the cement plant in depth, numerous skill checks, overview of character attributes, intertwined Library Use and Medicine checks, gradually approaching the truth

conversation.speaker: player8
conversation.text: "Next is the cement factory?"

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "That's right, but we might have to go tomorrow instead."

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: "Hmm, yes, it's getting late."

conversation.speaker: player8
conversation.text: "Uh, should we sleep? Rest is very important."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: You neatly gather the ancient texts and scrolls on the desk, extinguish the kerosene lamp, and fall into a deep sleep.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Qiduo received! Continuing to record for you 'Bread or Stone (Węgrów 1923)', currently 936 texts recorded, time elapsed 5 hours 36 minutes 17 seconds.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: Last time, it was said that the investigators failed to find Dr. Berenzada at the hospital, and instead met player9 who was raising funds for his sister's medical expenses. After hiring this local guide, they understood the clues left by player8's father through him, then proceeded to the Eximious Bookstore to retrieve the books left by Professor Moric. The receipt and note tucked inside the book directed them to the reliable Sali Warehouse. Near the warehouse in a small park, they retrieved a key from the mud of a birdbath, used the key to get the crate, which contained a notebook, a box, scrolls, and books. The notebook's contents revealed the history of the Sacred Shield Society and the origin of the Serpent's Claw, i.e., the Flaying Blade, and mentioned speaking with Dr. Golan Berenzada and going to the Bratović Cement Factory. After organizing the documents, the investigators decided to visit the doctor again the next day and explore the cement factory.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Get up, pack my things, as usual prepare to eat breakfast, wait for everyone downstairs.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: #Stretch, another energetic day after getting up.

conversation.speaker: player9
conversation.text: "Good morning, everyone, what do you need me to do for you today?"

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: #GoGoGo!

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: #Finish washing up honestly and gather.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: Go to the cement factory, understand?

conversation.speaker: player8
conversation.text: "Go!"

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Yes, and also be ready as bodyguards, the muscle."

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: #Take the lead, go out and hail a taxi.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: While you are waiting for each other in the lobby, five policemen quickly enter the hotel lobby. The leader is a tall officer with silver tassels on his epaulets. Under his dark brown curly hair are two thick eyebrows. He is currently rapping his knuckles on the front desk, demanding sharply: "Who has checked in in the past few days since the railway was destroyed? Bring out the register, must account for everyone's whereabouts individually!" It seems the police are taking the recent anarchist case very seriously. You leave the hotel and hail a taxi.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Prepare to go to the entrance and hail a taxi to the cement factory area.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: The taxi driver you hailed is a middle-aged man with graying hair. He casts a puzzled look through the rearview mirror: "Bratović Cement Factory? That place has been abandoned for years, even stray dogs don't want to go there. If you want to see scenery, I know a few nice nature reserves."

conversation.speaker: player9
conversation.text: "We have some business to attend to, take the fastest route."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Hmm... field investigation. We need to conduct new development and research on that area."

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: "It's fine, buddy, we also need to take photos and study it thoroughly."

conversation.speaker: player8
conversation.text: "Exactly."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Thank you, driver."

conversation.speaker: player8
conversation.text: (Not a rich guy anymore, not used to it ( )

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: The driver grins and floors the accelerator. Half an hour later, you get out of the car feeling dizzy. Before you is a factory surrounded by a six-foot-high brick wall, covered with barbed wire, the air thick with a strong animal stench. At the rusty iron gate stand three Serbs: the one on the far left has an empty right sleeve fluttering in the wind, the one in the middle has his left arm severed at the shoulder, burn scars stretching from his neck to his jaw, and the last one has lost his right eye, covered with a black eye patch. They are all holding guns, watching you warily.

conversation.speaker: player9
conversation.text: #Put the employer behind me, warily sizing up these three people.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: #Raise both hands to show I have no hostile intent.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: The Serb who lost his right arm steps forward. His cloudy eyes sweep over your faces, his throat emitting a voice like sandpaper rubbing: "State your names and your business."

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: "We... are just passing by for a joyride, believe us?"

conversation.speaker: player9
conversation.text: #Step forward

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: The disfigured one-armed man suddenly raised his pistol, his charred skin twisted into a ferocious expression: "Either explain clearly, or leave."

conversation.speaker: player8
conversation.text: #Get out of the car "Among you, does anyone know Mr. Golan?"

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: The man who lost his right arm raised his hand to stop his companion: "Mr. Golan is our master. Do you have business to discuss?"

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "This one's father, that professor, once came to visit Mr. Golan."

conversation.speaker: player9
conversation.text: #Silently step aside to make room.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "We want to find him to ask about some things, I wonder if you could accommodate us."

conversation.speaker: player8
conversation.text: #Clap hands "Then things will be easier."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: The one-armed man slightly nodded: "Unfortunately, Dr. Golan is currently on duty at the hospital, he only comes here for research every day at noon."

conversation.speaker: player8
conversation.text: "Why did Uncle Golan have you stay here to ensure outsiders can't enter?"

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "No comment."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "Wow, what a great person." #Eyes sparkling.

conversation.speaker: player8
conversation.text: #Shrug "Since you put it that way." #Look back at the road, is the driver still there?

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Hmm, alright then, we understand."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: The taxi driver is leaning against the car door puffing smoke, smoke rings shimmering bluish-gray in the sunlight. He sees you look back and lazily waves the hand holding the cigarette, embers scattering in the wind.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: .ra Listen

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Belief arises from desire, if it is what you hope for, it will surely receive a response, <player6>'s listening prayer:

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: Johnson hears faint barking and livestock grunts from inside the wall, like common animal noises in a farm.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: #Quietly elbow companions, signaling them to listen to the sounds.

conversation.speaker: player8
conversation.text: "Feels like it's to cover something up."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: The taxi driver stubs out the cigarette butt, grinding it into fragments under his shoe. He opens the car door and asks: "Where to now?"

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Hospital."

conversation.speaker: player8
conversation.text: "Hospital."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: At a quarter past nine, the car stops at the hospital entrance. You come to the front desk, the receptionist from yesterday shows a professional smile: "Coincidentally, Dr. Golan received the message you left yesterday and just called your hotel, inviting you all to meet."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Okay, thank you very much."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: After you knock, a deep male voice comes from behind the door: "Come in." Pushing the door open, you see a middle-aged doctor in a white coat bent over writing, pen scratching on paper. He doesn't look up, just gestures to the empty chairs opposite: "Please sit, describe the symptoms."

conversation.speaker: player8
conversation.text: "The symptom is my dad is missing."

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: #Snort, almost couldn't hold back.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: Dr. Golan looks up, his gaze behind gold-rimmed glasses filled with confusion, the pen pausing slightly between his fingers: "Sorry, I don't understand what you mean?"

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: "Well, she's right..." #Nod in agreement.

conversation.speaker: player8
conversation.text: "My name is player8."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: Dr. Golan immediately stands up, gesturing for you to take a seat, and gently pushes teacups towards everyone: "So you are Dr. Dragomir's daughter, my apologies. My schedule has been extremely packed lately, please forgive me." He adjusts his gold-rimmed glasses, "What brings you all here to inquire?"

conversation.speaker: player8
conversation.text: "Well, the things my father left behind led us to the cement factory." #Makes a circle with a finger. "Father should have mentioned it to you, a few veterans are guarding the place."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "We'd like to ask about the circumstances before the doctor's disappearance."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: Dr. Golan gently strokes the rim of his teacup, his gaze growing distant: Your father often discussed archaeological discoveries with me recently, but unfortunately, we were both busy with our own affairs and didn't have much time together. Ever since the findings from the Crusader's Tomb excavation were published in the newspaper, Dragomir completely changed. Those unearthed artifacts made him restless, and he kept repeating that they shouldn't have been disturbed. The doctor suddenly tightens his fingers, What pains me most is that he even refused basic academic discussions. Last week when we argued, his eyes were completely bloodshot. I haven't seen him for several days now...

conversation.speaker: player10
conversation.text: Qiduo received! Continuing to record Bread or Stone (Węgrów 1923) for you. Currently, 1070 text entries have been recorded, time elapsed: 6 hours, 35 minutes, 10 seconds.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: Last time, the story began with the investigators stranded on the Orient Express in Węgrów. The tracks were blown up by anarchists, forcing them to stay in this unfamiliar town. It was here they met the linguist player8 Moric, who was being followed by unidentified individuals as soon as she got off the train. After a sudden street conflict, the investigators bravely helped her escape danger and learned that her father, archaeologist Dr. Dragomir Moric, had disappeared after leaving behind some mysterious clues.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Sigh, this is truly so sad... Did he tell you, sir, about his discoveries at the archaeological site?"

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: Dr. Golan places the teacup back on the tray: "He did repeatedly mention the Crusader's Tomb. He said it contained things that shouldn't be there."

conversation.speaker: player8
conversation.text: "What did you talk about when you last met with my father?"

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Sir, I'd like to ask, is the archaeological site still accessible now?"

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "The last time he came to see me, he insisted on destroying that serpentine dagger. You must understand, any unearthed artifact carries historical value..." The doctor's voice gradually lowers, "Those successive newspaper reports drove him mad. The archaeological site is now sealed off by the city government; ordinary people cannot enter."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Sir, is that serpentine dagger a relic excavated during the archaeology?"

conversation.speaker: player8
conversation.text: "Has that weapon been destroyed now?"

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "That serpentine dagger is indeed a core artifact from the tomb. Your father insisted it contained dangers beyond comprehension... Perhaps the betrayal of someone close leaking the excavation progress to the newspapers truly shattered his judgment."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Is there anyone suspicious on the current archaeological team member list?"

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: Dr. Golan gently shakes his head: "I haven't investigated the archaeological team member list; I'm not familiar with that situation."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: Looks like we need another way to enter the archaeological site.

conversation.speaker: player8
conversation.text: "And, what did father leave behind at the factory?"

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "The doctor always returned home to live during the archaeological period. When I visited his residence recently, I found it empty. All his personal belongings were gone. I had assumed he returned to Zagreb."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "It seems someone is very curious about the doctor's archaeological findings."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: Dr. Golan frowns in confusion: "Left something at the factory? I don't understand what you mean..."

conversation.speaker: player8
conversation.text: "Dr. Golan, did father mention the Bratović Cement Factory to you?"

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "He did mention it. During our last meeting, he wanted to borrow the hydraulic press at my research institute, the former cement factory. The original factory owner was an old acquaintance of mine. After he went bankrupt five months ago, I purchased that factory area at a low price. After all, the medical school urgently needs to expand its laboratories, and the machinery inside hasn't found suitable buyers yet, so it's been sitting there."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Alright, thank you for your trouble, sir."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "Agreed."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: You leave the office and head towards the hospital entrance. Passing by the front desk, a nurse quickly catches up, holding a dark blue metal cup: "Everyone, please wait! You are Dr. Golan's friends, right? Dr. Golan just hurriedly logged off early and forgot to take this." She hands over the cup, showing a helpless smile, "I'm off tomorrow. If you see the doctor, please return it to him. He always says he can't work without coffee."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Sure, no problem. I'll take this cup then."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: The nurse smiles and nods before leaving. You examine the dark blue metal cup. The cup body reflects uniform metallic luster under the light, feels cool and smooth to the touch, has no scratches on the surface, and is well-made.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Hmm, a very delicate water cup." "Should we return it now or go to the newspaper office first?"

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: The editorial office of the Sybaris Gazette is located in a noisy printing factory in the town center. The smell of ink permeates the air, dark ink stains remain on the concrete floor, and the walls are covered with photos of Węgrów's street scenes. A reporter is typing rapidly on a typewriter to write a report, while the sound of water from an editor developing photos comes from the darkroom in the back.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Coughs lightly, prepares to go to the front desk to buy recent newspapers, trying to find news related to archaeological events.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: #Steps forward to help. .ra Library

conversation.speaker: player10
conversation.text: Belief arises from desire; if it is what you hope for, it will surely be answered. <player3>'s Library prayer: D100=91/70 Failure - Well... just a little off.

conversation.speaker: player10
conversation.text: Belief arises from desire; if it is what you hope for, it will surely be answered. <player4>'s Library prayer: D100=20/89 Hard Success - Is the difficulty level enough? Not alone? Then it's fine.

conversation.speaker: player8
conversation.text: (And also Gala Game)

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #After finding the corresponding content, take a look at who published this report.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: Although player8's Serbo-Croatian translation is fluent, the little doctor is unfamiliar with local news layout, so her information retrieval progresses slowly. player9 guides Bai Lan to flip through bound volumes, finally finding the target in a corner of a newspaper from three months ago: this report first disclosed the discovery of the Crusader's Tomb and mentioned that Dr. Moric was invited to participate in the appraisal. According to existing records, there had never been similar archaeological discoveries locally before that date. Published by Vesna Femić.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Tsk..." "Hello... I'd like to ask if this report on the Crusader archaeological research was published by this gentleman... Vesna Femić? ... Hmm... For certain reasons, I wonder if you could introduce us?" #Pulls her translator to the front desk, hands over a tip while letting the translator speak.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: The front desk secretary, Biserka Odak, raises her chin. This Croatian woman in her thirties lets out a short, derisive snort from her nose upon hearing Vesna Femić's name: That lady? She hasn't worked here for a long time.

conversation.text: .stshow Charm

I remember this lady interviewed that doctor before. We wanted to ask her about the doctor's whereabouts. Could you possibly make an exception?" .ra Persuade
